feedback_findings: Thirteen quick-mode targets skipped for missing default profile. No candidate verification started in quick mode.
Normal mode started only target 1 of 13, on 5GHz channel 161 using Reaver 1.6.6. Source address and channel readbacks passed.

Observed timeline before the final repeated sample: three association records, 26 EAPOL start records, two start failures and two transaction failures with native code 2. No identity request or M1/M3/M5/M7 was recorded. These are sampled log observations, not exact packet counts.
Normal mode was manually cancelled after approximately two minutes of candidate observation. Process stop and wireless cleanup were confirmed.

This identifies a failure before WPS credential validation, but does not distinguish target-side PIN availability from over-air/driver interaction. Kernel interface readback alone does not certify packet exchange.
changes: Shared monotonic candidate clock resets only on candidate change; same-candidate retries retain elapsed time. Fresh tracker per target.
Mean speed is observed candidate transitions per minute since the first observed candidate, including current waits. Before the first transition show collecting rather than a fabricated speed.

Receive-idle deadline starts on a reported candidate and resets on new identity/M1/M3/M5/M7/NACK/EAP failure observations. Replayed tails, beacons, association and outgoing EAPOL do not extend the deadline.

After 60 seconds of receive idle, stop and checkpoint the owned process, finish that target and continue the batch. Additional rounds or combo phases are not started for a timed-out target. Quick mode retains its shorter 15-second target budget.
Progress uses existing worker updates and immutable snapshots; no UI timer or new remote command/argument. Existing themes/layout retained with additional requested status text.

compatibility.shared_logic: Windows and Debian use the same pure Python monotonic timing and snapshot formatting. All native commands, tuning and owned-resource cleanup paths are unchanged.
compatibility.sources: Verified cached Reaver v1.6.5 and v1.6.6 defs.h from build/wps-runtime-audit and its sources.json; numeric code 2 is RX_TIMEOUT, distinct from KEY_REJECTED.
compatibility.runtime_limit: The cutoff is enforced on the existing bounded worker polling path. In-flight transport/checkpoint calls can delay the next check.

activation: Restart the source app before using the new timing and no-reply policy. No release package was built.
